title: Private workers in Cagayan Valley to get P30-40 daily wage hike

blocks.text: CITY OF ILAGAN, Isabela- The Department of Labor and Employment will add P30 to P40 to the daily minimum wage earned by Cagayan Valley private workers on December 16. The Regional Tripartite Wages and Productivity Board approved an increase from the P500 minimum to P540 for the cities of Ilagan, Santiago, Cauayan, and Tuguegarao and P530 in other towns of the region. Domestic workers in the region will receive a P500 monthly increase, raising their minimum wage from P6,500 to P7,000.
